verdict.rationale: Alloy's transaction-monitoring workflows apply policy logic and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met. That is a documented path from automated decisioning to human investigation, and its docs also reference manual review events and auditable agentic automation. However, nothing shows policy controls that specifically cap what the agentic automation may do on its own, or routing that targets ambiguous (as opposed to threshold-exceeding) findings to a human. Missing for 10: explicit policy guardrails limiting agentic auto-remediation, documented escalation of ambiguous/low-confidence findings to human review queues, detail on the manual review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can limit automatic remediation by policy and escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human
